Update (2026-11-19 PST): `test.yml` on main at fa383b1d195 (run 44534782876, job `sweep (windows)` 135597358757): 9 failed, 20,241 passed. All 14 failures listed above are gone (fixed by 8c7a9d2ef76, 6140d037413, fed304b2973 and others). New failures, none present at 92d3f373e2c:
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py`: 8 drift tests (`test_code_drift_in_dependency_file_invalidates`, `test_container_child_declared_file_drift_invalidates`, `test_container_unrelated_commit_does_not_invalidate`, `test_drift_refresh_escalates_on_probe_finding`, `test_drift_refresh_reuses_on_immaterial_drift`, `test_drift_refreshed_attestation_carries_a_verified_at_sha`, `test_progressive_drift_refresh_always_takes_probe`, `test_refreshed_attestation_rebinds_to_current_code`). Claim fails with "cannot confirm the code the plan was reviewed against is current" instead of the expected drift verdict.
- `tests/unit/test_fixture_env_repr_security.py::test_fixture_failure_does_not_render_unrelated_ambient_secret[tests.scripts.test_observability_exit-healthy_env-None]`.
Commits merged between the two runs: 79f46cde8a4 (snapshot build paths), 6140d037413, 8c7a9d2ef76, f8e9ea0e61f, fed304b2973, 5cde271a8ee, fa383b1d195. Which one introduced the drift failures has not been established.
